decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1) The proposed extensions, by reason of their bulk, size, scale and proportion, would create an obtrusive feature harmful to the appearance of the property and the proposal is therefore not consistent with policies ENV-B.1.1  (All New Development) and H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - 
2) Given its excessive and disproportionate size and bulk and the unbalancing effect, disrupting the original design of this matching pair of houses, within the St. Paul's Church Conservation area it is considered that the development would be visually obtrusive and would harm the character and appearance of the surrounding area. It is therefore not consistent with policies ENV-B.1.1  (All New Development) and H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions) and ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow UDP and the Residential Extension Guidelines (REG 2002).
description: Erection of a two-storey side and two storey rear extension and erection of a single storey rear extension to house.
